questions.question: What sign-act did Ezekiel perform with a brick in chapter 4?
options: Portrayed the siege of Jerusalem on it
Carved an idol of the king upon it
Built a small altar out of many of them
Wrote the names of the twelve tribes on it
questions.answer: Portrayed the siege of Jerusalem on it

questions.question: What did Ezekiel do while lying on his side for many days?
options: Kept a constant watch for the approaching enemy army from afar
Fasted from all food and from all water in deep and bitter mourning
Bore the punishment of Israel and Judah, a day for each year
Recited aloud the whole law of Moses over and over again
questions.answer: Bore the punishment of Israel and Judah, a day for each year

questions.question: Ezekiel was to eat rationed food cooked over fuel, picturing the scarcity of the siege.
Ezekiel lay on his left side _____ days for the house of Israel.
This is a sign for the house of _____, said the LORD.
